cases.brief: 把海报的标题放大一点

manual_findings: The title is visibly but modestly enlarged, matching ‘一点’.
Unrelated layout, copy, palette, and imagery are preserved.
No unrelated logo or brand is introduced.
The title is enlarged dramatically rather than slightly.
A Curify logo is added even though the task prohibits unrelated logos.
The requested edit is obvious, but preservation is weaker than Canva.

cases.winner_basis: Better proportional edit and stronger preservation of unrelated content.

cases.brief: try on this jacket on my photo for a lookbook

manual_findings: Candidate 1 broadly preserves the supplied person's recognizable identity and full-body pose.
Candidate 2 replaces the supplied person with a different white male model, failing identity preservation.
Both candidates use a navy bomber silhouette and color close to the garment reference.
Both invent a sleeve zipper pocket and change some garment details.
Two clean try-on images are delivered, not the required three poster directions plus manifest.
The deployed UI uploaded the person reference and omitted the navy bomber input.
The result replaces the requested bomber with an invented black leather biker jacket.
The result has a stronger poster hierarchy, but its core garment evidence contradicts the brief.
Only one image and no manifest were delivered.

cases.winner_basis: Better garment-reference fidelity and one identity-preserving candidate, despite the second candidate's identity failure; both agents still fail the delivery contract.

aggregate.reason: Only two cases are present and judge-v2 numeric scoring is blocked by provider spend cap.
